scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run api:dev" "pnpm run web:dev"
scripts.generate: pnpm run generate:openapi && pnpm --filter web run generate
scripts.generate:openapi: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
